Title: General Availability: Centrally Managed Azure Hybrid Benefit for SQL Server
Services: SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
Centrally managed Azure Hybrid Benefit for SQL Server allows you to manage and assign your Azure Hybrid Benefit SQL Server licenses at scale by applying them across an entire Azure subscription or billing account. Remain compliant by limiting number of roles who can apply licenses and optimize Azure Hybrid Benefit licensing utilization with proactive tracking and monitoring tools within the platform. This increased visibility allows you to identify additional cost saving opportunities and enables you to get the most value out of your SQL Server investments.

To learn more visit the below resources:

Microsoft Documentation

Demo Video

SQL Server Blog
